definitions.explanation: A special broadcast or extended episode of a TV program, typically aired during holidays or special occasions.
Abbreviation for 'security police' or security personnel who protect VIPs and public figures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧SP⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the year-end special.

examples.japanese: 2⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧SP⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}される→放送する：01852_housousuru⟧。
examples.english: A two-hour special will be broadcast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧SP⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: A special episode of the popular drama has been confirmed.

examples.japanese: SP⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{総理|そうり}→総理：13856_souri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{警護|けいご}→警護：23440_keigo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Security personnel are protecting the prime minister.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名人|ゆうめいじん}→有名人：17812_yuumeijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧SP⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
SP⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{守|まも}られ→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: They entered the venue while being protected by security personnel.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Sense 1: Abbreviation of English 'special'.
Sense 2: Abbreviation of 'security police'.

USAGE:
Sense 1 is very common in TV programming, especially for:
- Holiday specials (⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧)
- Extended episodes
- One-time special broadcasts

Sense 2 refers specifically to protection officers, often seen with politicians and celebrities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- SP⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧ - special program
- ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧SP - year-end special
- 2⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧SP - two-hour special
